direct_endpoint.note: Raw chart endpoint is aggressively rate limited without cookie/crumb; the yfinance client performs the cookie+crumb handshake automatically.

providers.rate_limits: Unofficial API. Observed HTTP 429 on the raw chart endpoint; yfinance survives by doing a cookie/crumb handshake and retrying. No published quota - must be paced client-side.
